notes:
assumed:true — written from the existing system because the user delegated design decisions ("as long as you do cool things, i am okay with anything"). Run /ui-setup to confirm or change.

Source of truth for tokens: `frontend/src/styles/index.css` (Tailwind v4 `@import 'tailwindcss'` + `@custom-variant dark`, no tailwind.config file). Do not create a second token set — extend that file.

Conventions already in place and binding for all future UI work:
- Instrument-panel aesthetic: graphite surfaces, hairline rules, sharp 0.25rem radius, one signal colour (the accent) for interaction only.
- Colour is data. `--obs` (observed, silver/ink), `--model` (ML, violet), `--aemet` (AEMET, amber) are reserved for series; `--ok/--warn/--bad` are semantic only. Never reuse them for chrome.
- Both themes must be handled by the same tokens (light + `.dark`). Never hardcode a hex in a component; use the `--color-*` Tailwind theme mappings.
- Data ramps (planned, roadmap U4) are a separate family to add here: `--temp-1..7`, `--rain-1..5`, `--wind-1..4` — sequential, perceptually even, colour-blind safe; never substitute for the series colours above.
- Charts read oldest -> newest (API contract); x-axis is time, left to right.
- Map already uses MapLibre + Carto vector basemap + Terrarium hillshade + RainViewer radar in `src/components/map/StationMap.tsx`. Keep those providers (keyless); no paid tiles.
- A11y: never encode meaning in colour alone (pair with a label/icon); honour `prefers-reduced-motion`; visible focus; 16px inputs on mobile.
- Feedback states (loading skeleton, empty, error) come from `src/components/shell/Feedback.tsx`; reuse rather than re-implement.
